subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's internal yielding glob walker and bootstrap-hook interleaving changes as the scoped fix for #87509 before broader Gateway worker/offload work?
rationale: The code path appears to address the reported stall, but it changes compatibility-sensitive scheduling and traversal behavior used during agent bootstrap and plugin hook handling.

options.title: Accept focused mitigation
options.body: Merge after maintainer review if the traversal and hook interleaving changes are acceptable internal behavior for protecting Gateway availability.

options.title: Require connected proof
options.body: Ask for a full embedded_run/channel proof showing keepalives or cheap Gateway work proceeding during bootstrap before merge.

options.title: Defer to architecture work
options.body: Pause or close if maintainers prefer worker isolation, caching, or priority scheduling instead of changing current bootstrap traversal and hook scheduling.

recommendation.title: Accept focused mitigation
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer review if the traversal and hook interleaving changes are acceptable internal behavior for protecting Gateway availability.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected history ties most strongly to bootstrap read and internal hook/bootstrap architecture work.
